title: Solving Equations Graphically
page_title: Solving Equations Graphically | Edexcel International A Level (IAL) Maths Revision Notes 2020

blocks.text: What does solving simultaneous equations graphically mean?

blocks.alt: Solving Equations Graphically Notes Diagram 1, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md:
- This is a way to solve **simultaneous** **equations** (see Simultaneous Equations)
- Coordinates of the *intersections* are the **solutions**

blocks.text: How do I solve simultaneous equations using a graph?

blocks.alt: Solving Equations Graphically Notes Diagram 2, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md:
- Use **graphs** and **algebra** together
- **Sketch** a graph if it has not been given
- **Read/interpret** a graph if it has been given

blocks.alt: Solving Equations Graphically Notes Diagram 3, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md: - It can be difficult to tell from a sketch if graphs intersect once, more, or not at all

blocks.alt: Solving Equations Graphically - Notes Diagram 4, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md: When writing out your solutions to simultaneous equations, always pair the correct *x* solution with the correct *y* solution
